debt_service.title: Household Debt Service Ratios
debt_service.supports: Required debt payments divided by disposable income.
debt_service.extension: Observed credits and declared income are imperfect individual-income proxies; historical installments are historical burden proxies, not current aggregate obligations.

liquidity.title: Household Liquidity Buffers and Financial Stress
liquidity.author: Lydia Wang
liquidity.supports: Liquidity relative to income, debt net of liquid assets, and buffers against adverse cash-flow shocks.
liquidity.extension: Window-specific bank balances approximate liquid assets. Stress sizes and historical-window combinations are hypotheses, not calibrated forecasts.

amortization.title: Principles of Finance, 8.3 Loan Amortization
amortization.supports: Level-payment annuity and outstanding principal under fixed monthly interest.
amortization.extension: Normalize scheduled remaining principal and interest by observed income; hypothetical rate shifts do not imply the fixed loan reprices.

credibility.title: Credibility Theory
credibility.author: R. Norberg
credibility.supports: Combine individual experience and collective risk with exposure-dependent credibility.
credibility.extension: Beta-binomial late-payment posterior, uncertainty and exposure weight; concentration grid is predeclared. Cohort rates use context rows only.

volatility.title: Explainable AI for Credit Assessment in Banks
volatility.authors: P. D. de Lange; B. Melsom; Christian Bakke Vennerod; Sjur Westgaard
volatility.journal: Journal of Risk and Financial Management
volatility.supports: Credit-balance volatility and available credit contributed to default prediction in one unsecured-consumer-loan dataset.
volatility.extension: Temporal changes and normalized dispersion of account and bureau measures are proposed extensions, not results established for this competition.

subspaces.title: BaggingClassifier documentation
subspaces.extension: Semantic blocks with shared anchors and inner-only ensemble selection for Kumo; improvement is unproven.

interpretation: Sources support mechanisms. Window combinations, stress grids and their usefulness here are unproven extensions.
retention: Lazy materialization per 100-feature pack; no giant dense derived matrix.
